notes.title: Issues Resolved
notes.content:
[h1]Bugs Fixed and Improvements:[/h1]

[h2]Character Spawning Bug Fixed: [/h2]Addressed an issue where spawning characters would automatically trigger "extreme low poly mode," reducing graphical quality unnecessarily. This function no longer activates by default, maintaining intended visual settings unless adjusted by the player.
[h2]
Improved Ragdoll Physics: [/h2]Enhanced the ragdoll system to provide extremely realistic death animations, adding a deeper layer of immersion to the gameplay experience.

[h2]V-Sync Added: [/h2]Implemented vertical synchronization (V-Sync) to eliminate screen tearing, ensuring a smoother and more visually consistent gaming experience.

[h2]Clothing Appearance Glitch Resolved:[/h2] Fixed a bug where clothing would suddenly appear out of nowhere during gameplay. Transitions between different outfits and equipment are now seamless and natural.

[h2]Leg Dismemberment Issue Fixed:[/h2] Corrected a problem where the main character's leg would become dismembered inappropriately. Now, dismemberment mechanics are accurate and consistent with the game's physics engine.

[h2]Flying Department Buddies Bug Fixed: [/h2]Resolved a glitch causing department buddies to fly or float unexpectedly. NPC behavior has been stabilized to adhere to normal in-game physics.
[h2]
Sound Effect for Casing Impacts:[/h2] Introduced sound effects for bullet casings hitting surfaces, enhancing the audio experience and adding realism to combat scenarios.

Lighting Improvement in Department Area: Fixed an issue where the department area appeared overly dark. The lighting has been adjusted to be brighter and more visually pleasing, improving visibility and atmosphere.

[h1]Dear Community,
[/h1]
I want to express my deepest gratitude for your unwavering support and enthusiasm for Endorphin Vice. Your feedback, suggestions, and dedication have been invaluable in helping me shape and improve the game. I am thrilled to have such a passionate and engaged community, and I cannot thank you enough for being with me on this journey.

I have heard your feedback and am excited to announce that I will now be releasing weekly updates instead of monthly ones! This change will allow me to bring new features, improvements, and bug fixes to you more frequently, ensuring a continuously evolving and enhanced gameplay experience.

However, with more frequent updates, I need your help more than ever. Please continue to report any bugs or issues you encounter on our Discord server. Your reports are crucial in helping me identify and fix problems quickly, making the game better for everyone.

Thank you once again for your incredible support. I look forward to continuing this journey with you and making Endorphin Vice the best it can be!

In this latest update, I have introduced two exciting new weapons to the arsenal of players - the sawed-off shotgun and the machine gun. These weapons offer unique gameplay dynamics, adding an extra layer of intensity and variety to the combat experience.

Moreover, I am thrilled to announce the implementation of a comprehensive customization system. Players now have the freedom to personalize their characters like never before, with a vast selection of clothing items, including t-shirts, shirts, jeans, vests, helmets, and much more. This system allows players to express their individuality and create truly unique avatars, enhancing their immersion within the game world.

In addition to the new content, I have dedicated time to enhancing the visual fidelity of the game. The weapon meshes have been meticulously improved, resulting in more detailed and realistic models that add to the overall visual appeal.

But it doesn't end there - player experience is at the forefront of my priorities. I have diligently addressed and resolved various bugs that were affecting gameplay, such as camera issues and menu glitches. These fixes ensure a smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience, allowing players to fully immerse themselves in the game without any interruptions.
